name: session-hub
description: A pane listing every running Claude Code session on this machine (name, repo, branch, recent prompts and actions) with a Jump button to switch to it, plus recently ended sessions you can resume

recentCount.title: Recent sessions shown
recentCount.description: How many ended sessions the Recent list shows, 1 to 24. Each gets a letter hotkey (a, b, c, … skipping s and x). Default 8.

promptCount.title: Prompts per session
promptCount.description: How many of a running session's last prompts each row shows, 0 to 10; a past session shows one fewer. Default 3.

actionCount.title: Tool calls per session
actionCount.description: How many of a running session's last tool calls (commands run, files edited) each row shows, 0 to 10. Default 3.
